arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, signal
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
sys.argv=['x']
import t_random2, ref
from harness import run
def handler(sig,frame):
    import traceback
    traceback.print_stack(frame)
    raise SystemExit(1)
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,handler)
for seed in range(8):
    job=t_random2.build(seed)
    print('seed',seed,'built',flush=True)
    signal.alarm(20)
    t=time.time(); mine=run(job)
    print('  mine %.2fs'%(time.time()-t),flush=True)
    t=time.time(); theirs=ref.run(job)
    print('  ref %.2fs'%(time.time()-t),flush=True)
    signal.alarm(0)
    same=all(mine[k]==theirs[k] for k in ('rejected','manifest','snapshots','active_requests'))
    print('  same',same,flush=True)
print('done')
PYEOF
